editorial:
Awake throws you into one of the scariest medical nightmares imaginable: being fully conscious but unable to move while surgeons operate on your heart. Hayden Christensen plays Clay, a wealthy young man who needs a transplant and trusts his best friend, a doctor, to perform it. Jessica Alba plays his new wife, and the tension builds as Clay realizes something is very wrong on the operating table. The movie keeps you guessing about who you can trust, mixing hospital drama with a slow-burn mystery that gets darker as secrets come out.

The acting is solid, especially from Terrence Howard and Lena Olin, who bring real weight to their roles. The pacing is tight and the twists land well, though some plot points feel a little too convenient. If you enjoy thrillers with medical settings and betrayal, this one is a fun, tense ride. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final twist, Clay discovers his wife Sam and his surgeon friend Jack planned to kill him during surgery to steal his fortune. While Clay is awake and paralyzed, his mother Lilith uncovers the plot and confronts Sam. Lilith injects Sam with a lethal dose, killing her, and Jack is stopped before he can finish the job. Clay survives the transplant and wakes up, finally free of the betrayal.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves medical thrillers and betrayal stories.
